content:
nina_csm: Heads-up 1: we observed intermittent auth 401s and delayed embeddings affecting some trial onboarding flows last night. Need an interim customer note and targeted outreach for trials with upcoming renewals.
omar_ops: Investigating. Initial cause: a cache compaction parameter change + onboarding surge caused premature token eviction; client retries amplified load. Rolled back change and applied a temporary retry-throttle. Monitoring shows error rate returning to baseline.

incident_bot: Hotfix deployed by omar_ops at 2025-06-04T02:12Z. Canary checks passing.

zoe_support: CS needs impacted tenant list & renewal windows to segment outreach (exec/high-touch vs standard).

nina_csm: Pulling list. High-touch: HelioHealth, BrightShelf, LexText. Mid: DataCart, PaperGrid. Low: SafeForms.

kevin_sales: For high-touch recommend exec escalation + 1-month credit + two priority onboarding sessions. Finance ok?

paul_finance: Pre-approve 1-month credits for flagged priority trials. Include explicit language: "one-month credit applied to next invoice or refunded on request." Log under CS-9950.

omar_ops: Short customer-facing blurb: "A background cache compaction change interacted with a traffic spike causing token evictions and auth failures for a subset of tenants. We reverted the change, increased cache headroom, and added retry throttles. Full RCA and timeline to follow."

nina_csm: Draft interim note below for review:

"Hi <Customer>,

We wanted to inform you about a transient service issue on 2025-06-03 that may have impacted onboarding. You may have seen authentication errors (401) or slower embedding responses.

What happened: a cache compaction change plus onboarding traffic spike caused some token state to be evicted prematurely, leading to retries and degraded performance for affected tenants.

What we did: we reverted the configuration change, applied a hotfix to increase cache headroom and added retry throttles. Telemetry indicates systems are stable.

Next steps: we'll deliver a detailed RCA within 48 hours, offer a one-month service credit (applied to your next invoice or refunded on request) or equivalent onboarding support, and prioritize environments for customers in active renewal windows. Please share any request IDs/times if you saw failures so we can correlate logs.

Sincerely,
Redwood Customer Success"

zoe_support: Looks good. I'll start priority outreach. nina_csm: Sending in 45 minutes unless objections. React :thumbsup: to proceed.

kevin_sales: :thumbsup:

omar_ops: :thumbsup:

incident_bot: Incident severity set to P2. Next automated update scheduled in 2 hours.
